description: This file defines an abstract class AwsTenantEventsBase that manages Amazon S3 bucket creation and deletion during tenant activation and removal events in OrchardCore, including bucket existence checks, creation, configuration, and cleanup.

classes.name: AwsTenantEventsBase
classes.description: An abstract class handling Amazon S3 bucket lifecycle events for OrchardCore tenants, including creation and removal logic.

methods.name: ActivatingAsync
methods.description: Checks if the S3 bucket exists; if not, creates it and sets public access restrictions during tenant activation.

methods.name: RemovingAsync
methods.description: Deletes the S3 bucket if configured to do so during tenant removal, handling errors and setting error messages.
